page.overview:
Who is Unidentified Balosar Jedi General?

A young Balosar Jedi Knight served as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. She had fought alongside the Navy Commander and Republic Intelligence officer Armen Sim multiple times during the war. After the war, Sim kept a hologram of her as his only memorabilia inside his apartment in the Imperial Elderblock 26-0640. During her investigation of the murder of her former neighbor Sim, the former Jedi Knight, Urbra Procura, who had also served alongside him during the war, found his holorecording of the Balosar and recognized her. Procura remembered her as wonderful and suspected that Sim had been in love with her even though he had must known that romantic relationships were against the Jedi Code.
